titulo_fr: Une fiche personnelle : Repérer les informations
intro: It is located in a brief form, name, age, city and languages. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It is located in a brief form, name, age, city and languages. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: Form questions are often followed by names, figures or answers from a word. In this fragment, «prénom» means «name».
